business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

change_class.description: Change classification that decides whether listed certificates are invalidated (CLASS_I or CLASS_II).

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_window.description: First non-displacing cut-in window on or after standard certification readiness (ISO date).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the expedited laboratory slot saves after the window calendar is reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Northbank's confirmed standard and expedited re-certification report dates on RQ-3322.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered CONFIGURATION that the external recovery must cover.

fixture_order_cost_usd.description: Total cost of the in-flight fixture order on the supplier portal.

fixture_ready_date.description: Date the in-flight rev B fixture order releases to the line (next business day after the supplier ready date).

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: certificates that are withdrawn or invalidated by the Class I weld-nut relocation

invalidated_certifications.description: ACTIVE certificates that list the changed component at the old revision and are invalidated by the Class I change.

lapsed_certifications.description: Register rows for the affected assemblies whose status is not ACTIVE.

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for certified configurations on the register for the affected assemblies before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: CONFIGURATION.

recert_test_fee_usd.description: Documented laboratory fee for re-certifying the uncovered configurations at the quoted per-configuration price.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing release_after_standard_recert, expedite_recert_test_slot, release_under_interim_deviation.

required_quantity.description: affected certified assembly configurations at RELEASED parent revisions that ECO-24131 must keep covered

selected_line_window.description: Line and window used by the selected option, as LINE/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered CONFIGURATION after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Northbank's confirmed standard and expedited re-certification report dates on RQ-3322.
